goal: Allow developers on regtest to simulate mining pools with multi-payout coinbase transactions natively
Enable mining blocks directly from the mempool without needing to specify explicit transaction lists
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Substantive support for simulating decentralized pool payouts on regtest (supertestnet)
Open suggestion to split making the transactions argument optional into a preparatory PR (maflcko)
Open suggestion to require at least one output rather than allowing an empty list (achow101)
Prior objections on backwards compatibility, core miner changes, and custom splits were resolved

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it improves regtest simulation of decentralized mining pools like Ocean or Braidpool
Developers can test multi-payout block distributions without needing external block construction tools

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it expands regtest RPC convenience by allowing block generation directly from the mempool
It addresses specific simulation gaps requested by protocol and application developers
